column1: # Minigame-only items: ids that cannot legally exist outside their minigame, so their grant
#   and exit strip are both non-economic and vanish before any settle stage (Coinflow
#   MinigameQuarantine evidence, Muse review, owner 2026-10-12). Persistent rewards stay
#   tracked: Castle Wars tickets and decorative armour, Soul Wars spoils, Barbarian Assault
#   penance rewards, tithe reward gear, and the Guardians of the Rift Rewards-Guardian items
#   (the crafted runes book too).
# Castle Wars supplies, arena ammunition and team colours (tickets and decorative armour stay tracked).
# Soul Wars gameplay items and tutorial loaners (spoils stay tracked).
# Barbarian Assault role items and dispenser ammunition (penance rewards stay tracked).
# Guardians of the Rift: cells, fragments, the guardian essence, the four guardian stones and
#   the portal talismans (the crafted runes and the Rewards-Guardian items stay tracked).
# Emir's Arena: the staging-area rune pouch is a temporary rune replacement (the Last Man
#   Standing pouch stays tracked: it is tradeable and its preset is region-covered).
# Nightmare Zone dream potions and provided items.
# Tithe Farm provided seeds, fruit and fertiliser (reward gear stays tracked).
# Tempoross: the ammo fish are minigame-only (not bankable, not tradeable, cannon ammunition);
#   the real-id tools still await the deferred HUD latch.
# Mastering Mixology: the pastes, the order potions in both states and the digweed are the
#   minigame's internal chain — the herbs book their cost at the refinery and the rewards book
#   when bought from Mixology Rewards (owner 2026-10-13).
# Sailing: shipwreck salvage is sorted into the loot, so the raw salvage is an intermediate — the
#   sorted drops book, the raw salvage never does (owner 2026-10-13). The cargo hold is readable
#   (InventoryID.SAILING_BOAT_1..5_CARGOHOLD) but the client syncs it through the interface only,
#   so it is not merged; one live session settles the design (owner 2026-10-13 review).
# Sailing port tasks: courier cargo and bounty monster parts only exist for a task - collected
#   at a ledger table or dropped from sea monsters, carried through the cargo hold and handed
#   in for the reward - so neither side of them ever books (owner 2026-10-13).
# Bounty monster parts (jaw, liver, ink sac, tentacle, fin, skin, feather, beak, mace, tusk,
#   blubber, teeth, head): dropped on task, claimed at any port master for coins.
# Sea charting: a sealed crate's one-shot drink bottle is only the wrapper - the real events
#   are its effects (loot granted, coins lost, damage), which always stay counted.
# Sailing unlock chain: a lost schematic, its small key and the lockbox directions only exist to
#   learn a recipe - digging, unlocking and reading never book; the facility's build materials do
#   (owner 2026-10-13 review).
# The full boat bottle only carries your boat; the empty bottle is a real tradeable item whose use
#   books like any other consumption (owner 2026-10-13 review).
